title: First and second derivatives of z ↦ h(x − s z) for an arbitrary h
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let h : ℝⁿ → ℝ (= Euclid n → ℝ) be an arbitrary function (no regularity assumed), let x ∈ ℝⁿ and s ∈ ℝ, and put G(z) := h(x − s z). Then for all y, a, b ∈ ℝⁿ: DG(y)a = −(s·Dh(x − s y)a) and D²G(y)(a, b) = s²·D²h(x − s y)(a, b). Here D = fderiv ℝ and D²F(y)(a, b) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 F y ![a, b] are Mathlib's total derivatives, which are 0 at points of non-differentiability.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (x : Euclid n) (s : ℝ) (y a b : Euclid n), fderiv ℝ (fun z : Euclid n => h (x - s • z)) y a = -(s * fderiv ℝ h (x - s • y) a) ∧ iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun z : Euclid n => h (x - s • z)) y ![a, b] = s ^ 2 * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h (x - s • y) ![a, b]
